u’re getting VERIFY_REQUIRES_EXECUTE because MBA’s stored phase is not EXECUTE at the moment you call MBA.verify(). In the current full-re-emit script, verify() is hard-gated on:

RUNSTATE.phase === "EXECUTE"

Even if you did run through many chats successfully, there are a few normal ways the phase can end up not being EXECUTE when you later try to verify:

A reload happened at a time when the runstate got overwritten (e.g., another call to plan() writes RUNSTATE).
